names.name: Hlai women's marks
names.said: Face, throat and legs, by lineage

practice.note: Hainan island; the pattern differed by lineage group.

text.what: Hainan: Hlai women marked on face, throat, arms and legs in patterns that told one lineage from another.
text.story: Chinese records notice tattooing among non-Han peoples as far north as the Yangzi in the first millennium, which is the same body of record that the Southeast Asian traditions on this site appear in — as somebody else's custom, seen from outside.
